verses.1: May God grant you justice as a king, and your righteousness as a prince.
verses.2: May your people be righteous, and may you judge them fairly.
verses.3: Let mountains bring peace to the people, and let valleys be filled with righteousness.
verses.4: The people of Aniye will be judged; the children of Eboon will be punished.
verses.5: May they fear you amidst the sun, and before each passing day.
verses.6: It will descend like a serpent upon the land of thorns and destruction.
verses.7: In his days, there will be righteous people and many who are happy, without any harm or trouble.
verses.8: And he would go from sea to sea, and from river to river, all over the land.
verses.9: Before him, the kings will fall; their enemies will be destroyed.
verses.10: The kings of Tarshish and Ehiyim will be honored. The kings of Sheba and Seba will also be honored. They will bring gifts to them.
verses.11: And all kings and all nations will worship him.
verses.12: For he will save his father from suffering, from poverty, and from having no one to help him.
verses.13: He will have mercy on Dal, Avion, and the souls of their ancestors.
verses.14: From within and from outside, their souls will be redeemed, and their blood will be valued in his eyes.
verses.15: And he will be given gold, and he will pray for him every day. May God bless him always.
verses.16: May there be a great noise in the land, at the top of the mountains. The little birds will make noise, and they will fly out of the city like seeds that scatter across the earth.
verses.17: May his name be remembered forever before the sun rises. May all nations bless him, and may they honor him.
verses.18: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, who performs wonders alone.
verses.19: And let his name be blessed forever; may his glory fill all the earth. Amen.
verses.20: All the prayers of David son of Jesse.
